snippet.title: Old School Chicken & Vegetable Patties | Bakery Style Puff Pastry
snippet.description:
Take a trip down memory lane with these authentic Bakery Style Chicken Vegetable Patties! In this step-by-step recipe, I’m sharing the exact bakery-style technique to achieve crisp, flaky golden puff pastry filled with a rich, savory chicken and mixed vegetable filling—just like the nostalgic patties sold in Pakistani school canteens during break time. Whether you are recreating your favorite childhood snack or baking fresh tea-time snacks for family and guests, this foolproof recipe delivers classic Pakistani bakery perfection right from your home oven.

Ingredients:

For Chicken Patties Filling:

Chicken Breast: 2 Pieces 
Salt: 0.5 Tsp (For cooking chicken), 1 Tsp (later)
Crushed Black Pepper: 0.5 Tsp (For cooking chicken), 1 Tbsp (later)
Oil: 2-3 Tbsp
Onion: 1 (small)
Flour: 3 Tbsp
Water: 2 cups

For Vegetable Patties Filling:

Potatoes: 1 (large)
Carrot: 1 (large)
Oil: 3-4 Tbsp
Onion: 1 (small)
Garlic: 1 Tsp
Ginger: 1 Tsp
Cumin Seeds: 0.5 Tsp
Tomato: 1 (Medium)
Turmeric Powder: 0.5 Tsp
Red Chili Powder: 1 Tsp
Green Peas: 1/3 Cup
Salt: 1 Tsp
Water: 2 Cups
Flour: 1 Tbsp

For Puff Pastry:

Puff Pastry: 0.5 Kg
Eggs: 2 (For Egg Wash)

snippet.title: ലോക്കറിലെ സ്വർണ്ണം | Mother-in-Law vs Daughter-in-Law | Not Cliche But Cliche | EP 105
snippet.description:
What happens when a woman's own gold becomes a source of conflict in her married life?

Marumakalude Swarnam is an emotional Malayalam short film that explores a familiar yet rarely discussed issue within many families—the control over a daughter's gold after marriage. A woman enters her husband's home with dreams, hopes, and the jewellery lovingly gifted to her by her parents. But after marriage, her mother-in-law believes the gold belongs to the husband's family and takes control of it.

When the daughter-in-law urgently needs her jewellery for a personal reason, she is denied access to what is rightfully hers. A gift that was meant to provide security and happiness turns into a painful reminder of control, helplessness, and the lack of independence she faces within her own family.

This story raises important questions about marriage, family relationships, women's rights, financial independence, and the expectations placed on daughters-in-law. Does marriage mean giving up personal freedom? Should a woman's belongings be controlled by others simply because she becomes part of a new family? How often do family traditions and expectations silence women's voices?

snippet.description:
Головні та найрезонансніші підсумки тижня в огляді ТСН: нищівні удари по Кримському мосту новими ракетами «Фламінго» та обвал ключової арки у відповідь на ворожі атаки по мостах Києва, істерична реакція Путіна та заяви Трампа. 00:36 — Масована атака на Дніпро: удари по підприємствах і шосе, є загиблі та поранені
